title: ReproGate outcome.json (schema 0.1-proto, unstable)
description: Contract for the recorded outcome of one evaluation. DOCUMENTATION ONLY: the runtime check is reprogate/invariants.py (stdlib, no jsonschema); tests keep the enums below equal to reprogate/constants.py. Cross-field rules are listed in x-invariants.

anchors_verified.description: evidence only (F-033): claim anchor fields with an EXACT_QUOTE anchor; the verdict does not use it

anchors_not_verified.description: evidence only (F-033): anchor field -> INFERRED, UNVERIFIED or a reject_reason

x-invariants: COUNTS_TOTAL: counts.total equals len(run_status); when the gate passed and claim_status is READY it also equals runs_requested (when present)
COUNTS_TALLY: counts.completed/env_failures/timeouts/invalid equal the tally of run_status

COUNTS_ORDER: matching <= completed; clean_completion_runs <= completed; per-outcome requirements (SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED: matching == completed >= max(2, min_completed); SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED_FLAKY: 2 <= matching < completed and completed >= min_completed; NO_MATCHING_REPRODUCTION_FOUND: matching == 0 and completed >= min_completed; INSUFFICIENT_VALID_RUNS: completed < min_completed; SINGLE_MATCH_ONLY: matching == 1)

REASON_OUTCOME: NONE only with SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED, SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED_FLAKY or NO_MATCHING_REPRODUCTION_FOUND; CLAIM_NEEDS_INFO, CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED, REPRODUCER_*, ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE only with NOT_EVALUATED; the remaining reasons only with INCONCLUSIVE
GATE_LINK: reproducer_status other than VALID requires NOT_EVALUATED, the matching REPRODUCER_* reason and no runs
CLAIM_LINK: claim_status other than READY (gate passed) requires NOT_EVALUATED with CLAIM_UNSUPPORTED or CLAIM_NEEDS_INFO
ENV_LINK: ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE requires at least one run and every run ENV_FAILURE
RUN_LINK: REPOSITORY_MODIFIED and VERIFIER_INTERNAL_ERROR require an INVALID run; TIMEOUT_NOT_CLAIMED requires no completed run and a TIMEOUT
PROVENANCE: SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED and SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED_FLAKY cannot be reported with claim_provenance INSUFFICIENT; CLAIM_PROVENANCE_INSUFFICIENT requires it
QUALIFIER: outcome_qualifier is PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIED exactly when claim_provenance is UNVERIFIED_ALLOWED
ORACLE: oracle_required true only for SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED or SYMPTOM_REPRODUCED_FLAKY (false inside an oracle bundle is allowed)
